passages.title: Describing Environmental Conditions
passages.text: Students described the river behind their school during a community project. Upstream, the water appeared clear and small fish could be seen near the stones. Beside the pedestrian bridge, floating plastic collected against the steps. Downstream, the water looked cloudy after heavy rain. The students recorded these observations at three locations but avoided blaming one source for the changes. They proposed collecting samples with a local environmental group before making stronger claims about water quality.
